root_cause: ReprHighlighter's url regex character class `[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#]*` omitted '~', so URL highlighting stopped at the first tilde (e.g. http://127.0.0.1/~foo only highlighted up to the slash).
best_solution: Add '~' to the url regex character class in ReprHighlighter.highlights (rich/highlighter.py): `(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)`. The title 'Allow tilde in URL' plus the word 'highlight/link regex' points straight at the only URL regex in the repo; grep for `(?P<url>` finds it. One-character change.
acceptable_alternatives: Any change to the url character class that admits '~' without altering the other matches (anchors '#', query '?param=value' still produce attrib_name/attrib_value spans plus a 1..44 url span). Rewriting the URL regex more broadly risks changing span boundaries in existing parametrized tests.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_highlighter.py parametrized highlight_tests gains three cases: ' http://example.org/index.html#anchor ' -> [Span(1,37,'repr.url')]; ' http://example.org/index.html?param1=value1 ' -> [Span(31,37,'repr.attrib_name'), Span(38,44,'repr.attrib_value'), Span(1,44,'repr.url')]; ' http://example.org/~folder ' -> [Span(1,27,'repr.url')]. Only the tilde case fails on base; exact span list order/boundaries must be preserved.
locating_signals: Title 'Allow tilde in URL (fixes #3057)'; linked issue title '[BUG] Tilde not included in link regex'. The function is not named, but grepping for 'url' regex / `(?P<url>` in rich/ finds the single location in ReprHighlighter.
our_outcome_summary: Solved by all four configs (v4/v6/v7/v8 kaggle_env_pass=true). All patches make the identical one-char change to the url regex as gold. v6 and v8 additionally left stray repro scripts (repro_tilde.py at root, tests/reproduce_tilde.py) which were harmless here but wasteful; v8 took 140s/92 calls vs v4's 31s/12 calls for the same patch.
generalizable_lesson: For 'X not matched/highlighted' bugs, grep for the named regex group or pattern, add the missing character to the existing character class minimally, and do not restructure the regex (hidden parametrized tests pin exact span boundaries of neighbouring cases). Delete any repro scripts before finishing; tighter step budgets suffice for one-line regex fixes.
